plan: I will bid a fraction of my value in the sealed bid auction. This fraction will be 0.8. This is because if I bid my true value, I will likely win, but my profit will be very small. By bidding less than my value, I risk losing, but I increase my expected profit if I win. I will use 0.8 as a starting point.

[My value is $9. In the ascending clock stage, I want to stay in as long as the clock price is below my value. Therefore, I want my exit price (sealed bid) to be $9. This ensures I win whenever the second-highest bid is less than or equal to my value, and I lose when another bidder values the item higher than I do. This strategy aims to maximize my profit in the long run by winning when I have a relatively high value and losing when I don't.]

[My value is $34. I want to win if the second-highest bid is less than my value. My bid in stage 1 determines my exit price in stage 2.
